payload.title: FND-09: Convert functional support to public process/edge observations
payload.requestedOutcome: Convert functional support helpers to public process and edge observations so no support helper exposes Petri or service internals. Preserve root.BuildProcess construction and edges.Edges external-effect overrides as the only test seams.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: No functional support helper exposes Petri markings/tokens/nets or private service internals.
Functional tests continue to construct only through root.BuildProcess and replace only external effects through edges.
Typecheck/lint and focused functional-support tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Shared functional support only; do not broaden into a full functional topology rewrite.
Do not change CLI-manifest ownership or provider conductor implementation.
Do not assert source-layout inventories as the only proof.

payload.title: FND-12: Capture public behavior baselines before service moves
payload.requestedOutcome: Capture behavior baselines for public CLI, HTTP, MCP, replay, and visualization activation so representative success and typed failure cases exist before package moves. Prefer reuse of existing focused/functional evidence over inventing meta source-scan tests.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Representative success and typed failure baselines exist for public CLI, HTTP, MCP, replay, and visualization activation.
Baselines are runnable before service package moves begin.
No meta tests that only scan source files or docs topology are added as the sole proof.
Typecheck/lint and the captured baseline suites pass.
scopeBoundaries: Baseline capture only; do not migrate service packages.
Do not refresh or own the live docs/models/mcp CLI-manifest baselines belonging to PR #1262 except by referencing them.
Do not change provider conductor behavior.

payload.title: PSS-F01: Freeze ownership inventory and path leases
payload.requestedOutcome: Freeze the deterministic migration inventory that assigns every production package, constructor, datastore, lifecycle role, protocol adapter, and cross-service import to one target owner, and publish the initial path-lease freeze that unblocks PSS-F02. Reuse FND-01 outputs where available; do not reopen top-level service-shape decisions.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Inventory covers production packages under pkg, seed services, additional current roots, and large responsibility clusters within each owner.
Every committed top-level and nested service has authority, state/store, lifecycle, consumers, transaction boundary, and failure/recovery rationale recorded.
Every cross-service edge is classified as command, query, event, protocol composition, construction, lifecycle, or external effect.
Providers, Provider Sessions, Operator Settings, System Bootstrap, Factory Visualization, and Recordings map to the committed tree without another discovery task.
Process Edges is recorded as the explicit architecture exception.
Inventory is stable-sorted and suitable for the exact deletion-only nonconformance ledger.
Typecheck/lint and focused inventory/lease freeze validation pass.
scopeBoundaries: Inventory and lease freeze only; do not perform owner package moves.
Do not bypass live portfolio holds on CLI manifest or provider conductor.
Do not create competing provider catalog/execution abstractions.
verification: focused ownership-inventory and path-lease freeze validation

payload.title: CTR-WORK: Publish additive Work root contract slices
payload.exclusiveLease: direct Go files in pkg/services/work root contract
payload.requestedOutcome: Publish additive Work root-contract slices for the singular Work interface covering admission, content staging/materialization, and state access without exposing implementation types. High-unlock priority: this unblocks IMP-WORK-* and several cross-owner IMP packets.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Work exposes one named root interface with plain request/result/value/typed-error contracts.
No peer implementation types appear in the root contract.
Representative success and typed failure characterization tests pass for the published slices.
Typecheck/lint and focused contract tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Root contract slices only; do not complete IMP-WORK nested cuts in this packet.
Do not change public OpenAPI solely for package motion.

payload.title: CTR-SES: Publish additive Factory Sessions root contract slices
payload.exclusiveLease: direct Go files in pkg/services/factory_sessions root contract
payload.requestedOutcome: Publish additive Factory Sessions root-contract slices that keep one aggregate session authority while preparing private nested capabilities. Reuse accepted packaged-structure-sessions evidence; do not make Sessions a global barrier for unrelated owners.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Factory Sessions exposes one named root interface with plain contracts.
Peer services cannot import nested session implementation contracts through the published root.
Representative success and typed failure characterization tests pass.
Typecheck/lint and focused contract tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Root contract slices only; nested IMP-SES packets remain separate.
Do not block Runtime/Workers owner-local packets by expanding this into a global prerequisite.
Do not take CLI-manifest or provider-conductor leases.
verification: focused Factory Sessions contract characterization tests

payload.requestedOutcome: Reconcile queue and session health; inspect evidence for FND-09/12, PSS-F01, CTR-WORK, and CTR-SES; update checklist/meta/progress; then open more non-colliding CTR stewards and ready IMP packets, or hold where portfolio contention remains.
